attributes.residual: NONE - fn_8004DB3C is byte-exact. fndiff --clean reports EXACT, 0 real diff lines; probe.py reports real 19 -> 0, insns exact, multiset 0t. MEASUREMENT THAT CORRECTED THE PARK'S LABEL (its stated purpose): regnorm reports 67 paired, 0 RENAMING, 9 STRUCTURAL, 1 unpaired - i.e. the function had ZERO register residual, so the legacy REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE label was wrong and the superseded record's STRUCTURAL re-class was right. The whole residual was one branch skeleton: target `cmpwi r3,0; bne ->0x44; b ->0xdc` versus ours `cmpwi r3,0; beq ->0xd8`, i.e. ours fused the conditional-over-unconditional pair and was one instruction SHORT at T60/O59. WHY THE THIRD FORM WON, stated because it is the transferable part: MWCC lowers two SEPARATE `if (...) return;` guards by short-circuiting each one directly to the epilogue, which fuses the last test into a single `beq`; lowering ONE guard whose condition is a || disjunction forces the final disjunct's FALSE edge to branch around to the body (`bne ->body`) and leaves the TRUE edge as an unconditional `b` to the epilogue - materialising exactly the unfused pair. Guard 1 fuses in target too (`bge ->0xdc`), and that asymmetry between the two guards inside one function was the tell that they were one combined condition in the original source, not two statements.
